privasi.title: Privacy Policy
privasi.p1: This website is managed by M. Revi Ramadhan as an individual (not a legal entity). All requests regarding your data can be sent to email revy8k@gmail.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.
privasi.p2:
When you create an account: name, email, and profile data (avatar, bio, website, date of birth) that you voluntarily fill in.
When you fill in the contact form: name, email, message, and budget (optional).
Technical data: login session cookies and basic security logs.
privasi.p3: The data we process is used to: manage your account access, reply to messages you send, keep the site secure, and display a public profile if you fill it in. The legal basis is your consent when submitting data and our legitimate interest to keep the service running.
privasi.p4: Account profile data is kept until you delete your account. Contact messages are kept until the inquiry is resolved. Security logs are kept for up to 90 days.
privasi.p5: This site runs on third-party infrastructure: Supabase (database storage), Vercel (hosting), and identity providers used for sign-in (Google OAuth). We do not sell or share your data for advertising.
privasi.p6: We use session cookies (login) and language preference (NEXT_LOCALE). There is no advertising or tracking. If an analytics service is added later, your consent will be requested first.
privasi.p7: You have the right to request access, correction, deletion, withdrawal of consent, and portability of your personal data. Simply send an email to revy8k@gmail.com with a description of your request.
privasi.p8: You can delete your own account via the account settings page (Profile → Delete Account). If that is not possible or your account is difficult to access, please email us and we will assist with the deletion.
privasi.p9: We apply reasonable technical measures: hashed passwords, secure sessions, and limited access to data. If a data breach occurs that affects you, we will notify you via your account email.
privasi.desc: How your personal data is processed on revy.my.id.

syarat.p2: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. Accounts used for abuse, spam, or illegal content may be disabled without prior notice.
syarat.p3: Articles, designs, and assets on this site belong to their respective owners. You may not copy or republish content from this site without written permission, unless stated otherwise (for example in the public tools).
syarat.p4: Data submitted through the contact form is used only to respond to your message, as described in the Privacy Policy.
syarat.p5: The tools and demo pages are provided "as is" — we make no warranty of accuracy, availability, or fitness for a particular purpose. We do not recommend running sensitive data through the public tools.
syarat.p6: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect losses or loss of data resulting from use of this site.
syarat.p7: We may change these terms at any time; the latest version is always available on this page. Significant changes will be communicated on the homepage.
